text:
Lena Q.: Quick idea 11 - small 'thank-you lunchbox' pop-up next Thursday during lunch to drive spot awards and quick peer notes. Each box has a mini card + QR to nominate. Need volunteers to pack and hand out. Budget estimate $220. Who's in? :bento:

Omar D.: Sounds fun. I can help pack in SF and handle vendor pickup. How many boxes?

Lena Q.: Target 120 boxes (HQ 80, SF 40). Packing party Wed 4pm at HQ shipping room. Need 4 volunteers.

Shannon R.: I can do packing Wed 4pm and help on Thu 11:30-12:30 handing them out.

HR Ops Bot: Policy check: spot awards up to $150 auto-approve for employees, contractors eligible up to $75 via non-cash vendor. Use project=Culture, code=LUNCH-SPOT.

Marta V.: I'll handle the bilingual cards (EN/ES) and print high-contrast versions for accessibility. Please add any names requiring alternative formatting.

Facilities Bot: Request received: reserve packing table Wed 3:30-5:00, and reserve floor 2 atrium for Thu 11:30-1:00. ADA path will be maintained.

Lena Q.: Thanks. Volunteers list so far: Omar, Shannon, Marta. Need one more for packing and one more for Thu shift. Anyone?

Omar D.: I can take an early Thu shift 11:30-12. Might need someone to cover 12-12:30.

Shannon R.: I'll stay until 12:30. Also can someone take photos for internal comms? Minimal, candid only.

Marta V.: I can snap a few quick pics. Will avoid faces unless consented.

Lena Q.: Logistics & timeline:

Wed 15:00 - final art to print shop
Wed 16:00 - packing party (HQ shipping room)
Thu 09:30 - vendor drops boxes at HQ reception
Thu 11:30-13:00 - distribution in floor 2 atrium
Thu 15:00 - tally nominations handed to recognition committee
Within 7 days - submit expenses (project=Culture, code=LUNCH-SPOT)

HR Ops Bot: Reminder: For any contractor award, route via /vendor-pay with tag LUNCH-CTOR. Attach receipts.

Finance Ops: Approved provisional spend. Please keep receipts and upload to /expense with the project code.

Lena Q.: Sheet for volunteers + dietary notes: https://go.redwood/sheets/lunchbox-volunteers 11 - add your name & any dietary restrictions. Also please don't include personal addresses in the sheet.

Omar D.: I'll add SF shipping heads and coordinate pickup times with vendor.

Shannon R.: Final ask: someone to help label boxes during packing (2-person task). @Marta can you take the lead?

Marta V.: Yep, I'll lead labeling. Thanks everyone! I'll post a reminder in #general Wed morning. :sparkles:
